text: Per @bubblemaps: 90 brand-new wallets, all funded from one address, bought 90% of $MYSTERY at launch. /  / They called it a "textbook scam." The price fell about 75% from its $7.5M peak. /  / This setup is everywhere in the trenches. How to spot it in 30 seconds 🧵
